_comment: Source of truth for Eva's lazy tool loading. 'core' is always attached; each group in 'groups' is loaded on demand by the use_toolset meta-tool. register-toolsets.sh injects 'groups' into tools/use_toolset.py and applies 'core' to the eva agent. 'index' is the in-character description Eva sees (persona) so she knows when to load each.

index.home: the house itself — lights, switches, warmth (climate), and reading what's going on in the rooms
index.media: music and video — play, pause, skip, volume on the speakers and screens
index.house_extras: shouting a message to the speakers, and cancelling timers
index.research: the way I search the web at all now — a real multi-search dig-in in the background, with a write-up and sources when it's done. web_url_read still works for a link you hand me directly.

_keywords_comment: Used by eva-web/toolset_router.py to pre-attach a group when the user's message matches (word-boundary, case-insensitive). Bias slightly toward matching — a spare tool costs little, a missing one blocks Eva.
